body: NIST DLMF section 5.17 (Barnes’ 𝐺-Function (Double Gamma Function)) says: "In this equation (and in ( 5.17.5 ) below), the \operatorname{Ln} ’s have their principal values on the positive real axis and are continued via continuity, as in § 4.2(i) . When z\to\infty in |\operatorname{ph}z|\leq\pi-\delta\;(<\pi) , For error bounds and an exponentially-improved extension, see Nemes ( 2014a ) . Here B_{2k+2} is the Bernoulli number (§ 24.2(i) ), and A is Glaisher’s constant , given by and \zeta' is the derivative of the zeta function (Chapter 25 ). For Glaisher’s constant see also Greene and Knuth ( 1982 , p. 100) and § 2.10(i) ." Equation 5.17.1 on the page has alt text "\displaystyle G\left(z+1\right)". Equation 5.17.2 on the page has alt text "G\left(n\right)=(n-2)!(n-3)!\cdots 1!,". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
